fusions.name: Writ of Pecking
fusions.desc: Serves a writ that deals 30 damage and curses the target, plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite it hits. Allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Loose Leaves
fusions.desc: Flutters 3 pages at once, each dealing 6 damage. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Orders
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
